target_customer: Hedge funds and investment firms with data pipelines needing human review
problem: Pipeline exceptions emailed to engineers for manual cleaning are slow and costly; sieve returns clean data via API or Excel.
business_model: usage/API pricing with expert-in-the-loop review (pricing not found)
product_category: Financial data cleaning and extraction API

founders.name: Nicole Lu
prior_employers: Citadel (equity quant research, global trading, data science)

technical_complexity.rationale: AI agents for source finding and extraction plus a human review workflow; applied LLM engineering, not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: API integration into pipelines creates some stickiness; extraction agents and reviewer networks are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source documents incumbents acting on this wedge.

market_need_then: Hedge funds run manual data-cleaning steps; sieve's own claims of 100% match to hand-collected data and 60-70% lower cost are company statements.

branding.domain_note: Uses usesieve.com (prefix, not exact .com); YC slug sieveai.

brand_strength.rationale: Evocative short name that describes filtering; no press or community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: sieve joined YC in Spring 2025 as a two-person team and is listed Active. Its only traction claims (multi-million dollar ARR, profitable, per the YC profile) are unverified company statements and no funding round was confirmed, so the outcome cannot yet be classified beyond early stage.
